Try the partial-receipt journey

Stage a two-pump request as Requester. Switch to Purchasing approver and create its PO. As Receiving, accept one unit under ACCEPT-001. As AP, import the two-unit invoice and inspect the hold. As Receiving, enter a new acceptance reference ACCEPT-002 and accept the second unit. The same invoice becomes ready. As AP, post it; as Payment approver, authorize; as Treasury, simulate payment.

3 / Receiving or service owner

Record acceptance.

For a second acceptance, use a new reference. Retrying the same reference and content does not create another receipt.

    4 / Accounts payable

    Stage the invoice.

    This entry form stages a single-line invoice. The two-line example demonstrates one header spanning two approved POs. Both use the shared simulation journal; taxes, credits and document extraction are outside this example.

    5 / Review, posting and settlement

    Resolve the same document.

    AP posts only after current-state checks pass. Payment approver authorizes separately; Treasury records the fictional settlement. No funds move.

    Resolve a simulated supplier correction

    The two-line example has a partial receipt and a repair-price discrepancy. Accept the remaining upgrade unit, then stage a simulated supplier revision as AP. Purchasing approver can approve or reject it; the original invoice stays visible.

    Original and revised invoice history

        All supplier documents, reviewers, corrections and financial results are simulated. Loading revised values does not alter the invoice until the separate review step approves them.

        Cost distributions and financial stages

        These stages are not added as separate costs. Receipt proxy is within open commitment. Posted invoices equal unpaid plus paid, including at each cost center.

        Traceability and recovery

          If saved progress changed, download your in-memory checkpoint before reloading. Damaged saved data stays untouched until you explicitly confirm a restart or validated checkpoint replacement.

          Checkpoint recovery replays validated commands against the fixed fictional policy snapshot. Unknown schemas, changed policy snapshots, and invalid transitions are rejected. This is not authenticated enterprise storage or tamper-proof audit evidence. Financial measures are the scoped teaching model, not a general ledger. Journal timestamps use a simulated clock. All system interactions are simulated for portfolio presentation; no company-system connection is required. Native report artifacts and additional accessibility acceptance remain separate showcase work.
